editorial:
Imagine looking back at your high school years and realizing one wrong turn changed everything. You get to follow four different teens who seem like typical students, but their lives are actually connected by a series of terrible choices. The movie shifts between their perspectives, showing you how a single moment of peer pressure or a lie can snowball into a total disaster. It feels like a cautionary tale that hits close to home, making you wonder what you would have done in their shoes while the tension slowly builds up.

What really works here is how the acting makes you feel the stress and regret of the characters. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit slow before the big payoffs. You will love the way the stories collide, even if some of the drama feels a bit heavy. If you are into stories about teen mistakes and consequences, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends by showing how the lies the four teens told finally catch up to them. After a huge confrontation, the truth comes out about the accident and the cover-up. You see the characters face the legal and social fallout of their actions. Instead of a happy ending, it wraps up with a sad look at their broken friendships, proving that some mistakes can never be fully fixed no matter how much you apologize.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty stories about high school secrets and the consequences of bad choices.
